author: dfoley323
body:
Deity ara is hands down the easiest class for endless.  I have 6 AL in it, and make it to 400-500 with about 3 minutes of buffing.  

Its a great class and is hugely popular but i feel like it is way overtuned (way to much dex compared to other classes) and is due for a nerf.  

I personally am a beoh for tower/horde dungeons, beoa for raids/tower boss.  

i definitly started t10 as a GSA cause its just easier, but it never speeds up so you find out quite quickly that gear is just helping you survive, not increasing your dmg that much.  With beoh, gear makes a huge difference and there are some amazing builds but they are highly linked to gear and amity.

Here is a tower climb
https://youtu.be/FOR-UnJD_Xs?feature=shared

Ok for those asking about endless 
This is with al 5.

Part 1 buffing , this is where I normally stop and get monument buffs going. Then I pop exp potions, orn coin, luck shrines etc ... For this video I didn't use any since I don't intend to do much. 
https://youtu.be/52CTOH2Vqj4?feature=shared

Part 2 how long do t buffs last ~50 rounds
https://youtu.be/UgvwHQ2IOko?feature=shared

This is with no monument buffs, no exp potions or coins
